subject: *: improve ErrKeyExists generation and MemoizeStr (#54412)
summary: Refactors duplicate-key error construction to centralize formatting via `kv.GenKeyExistsErr` (joining key column strings with "-" per MySQL style), updates executor batch duplicate checking and table record/index paths to pass column-string slices, and adjusts TiKV txn error extraction to use the new helper where key columns can be extracted; later history up to `upstream-master` shows these changes persist without follow-up fixes indicating a remaining Blocker/High issue.
